roadmap.title: Campaign Part 1
roadmap.description: Acts 1-5: zone full clears, act bosses, Bandit choice, Doedre/Maligaro/Shavronne, character unlocks, and the whole-campaign collections (waypoints, optional dialogue, optional quests, lore) that must be tracked from Act 1.

roadmap.title: Campaign Part 2
roadmap.description: Acts 6-10: Part 2 bosses (Brine King, Arakaali, Lunaris/Solaris, Depraved Trinity), Kitava-era story and Part 2 zone clears.

roadmap.title: Early endgame and character building
roadmap.description: Labyrinth, ascendancy, levels 60-90, resistances, charges, minion and totem builds, sockets, keystones.

roadmap.title: Crafting, corruption and trading
roadmap.description: Orb use, Vaal corruption, unique items, jewels, divination cards, Essence and Strongbox actions.

roadmap.title: Atlas and maps
roadmap.description: Map Device, Voidstones, Atlas completion, Atlas missions, Warbands, map modifiers, Tier 16 maps.

roadmap.title: Endgame bosses
roadmap.description: Elder, Shaper, Sirus, Maven, Atlas guardian bosses and Voidstone upgrades, Breachlords, Uber Atziri.

roadmap.title: Hardcore and PvP
roadmap.description: Hardcore league milestones, race events, PvP and party achievements.

achievements.description: Complete the Labyrinth in a non-Hardcore league.
achievements.summary: Finish the Normal Labyrinth on a character not in a Hardcore league.

guide.context: You must finish the whole run without leaving. Death, logging out and town portals all end the run.

steps.text: Finish six Trials of Ascendancy. Act 1: @loc{Lower Prison}. Act 2: @loc{Crypt Level 1} and @loc{Chamber of Sins Level 2}. Act 3: @loc{Crematorium}, @loc{Catacombs} and @loc{Imperial Gardens}.
Step through the Goddess statue in @loc{The Sarn Encampment} to arrive at @loc{Aspirants' Plaza}. That plaza has a waypoint you can use from any act. Pick the Normal Labyrinth.
Beat @enemy{Izaro} in all three Aspirant's Trials. Finishing the last one opens the Ascendancy Chamber.

achievements.description: Complete every side-quest as one character.
achievements.summary: Complete every optional side quest with one character.

guide.context: A side quest you skip stays available, so you can return to an earlier act later.

steps.text: Press U to open the quest screen. In each act, take every side quest you find.
Finish every side quest before you leave its act. Walk back with waypoints for any you missed.

achievements.description: Listen to all optional NPC dialogue as one character.
achievements.summary: Listen to every optional NPC dialogue line with one character.

guide.context: The count is 484 lines. A missed line cannot be heard again, and you need a new character. The dialogue route needs the kill-all choice from Eramir, so you cannot also hold the help-a-lord choice for the Bandit Lords unless you change it later with the vendor recipe.

steps.text: Use one character for the whole campaign. In every town, talk to each NPC after every story step and before you enter the next zone. A line you finished turns grey.

Act 1: Talk to Nessa, Bestel and Tarkleigh when you arrive, starting with Tarkleigh. After you kill @enemy{Oozeback Bloom}, talk to Bestel before you enter @loc{The Fetid Pool}. After you pick up the Glyphs, talk to Tarkleigh before you place them in the wall. After Piety blocks the passage, stay out of @loc{The Ship Graveyard} until you have talked. Do not kill @enemy{Brutus} until you have seen Piety, read Shavronne's Journal and heard the Brutus lines. Do not take the Allflame before you speak to Fairgraves and Bestel about him. Later, deliver the Allflame and kill Fairgraves, because Act 3 dialogue needs it.

Act 2: Do not talk to or kill any bandit before the Darkness triggers. Kill all three bandits, and talk to Eramir after each kill. Do not kill Kraityn while you work in the Fellshrine Ruins area. Talk to Eramir before you destroy the tree roots. Visit @loc{The Western Forest} before you clear @loc{The Chamber of Sins}, or its dialogue will not appear later.

Act 3: Speak to Maramoa, Hargan, Clarissa and Grigor when you arrive. Do not enter @loc{The Marketplace} after the undying blockage until you have spoken to Maramoa. Leave the Decanter Spiritus, the Ribbon Spool and the Thaumetic Sulphite on the ground until their lines are done. Talk to Maramoa before you kill Gravicius. Do not kill @enemy{Piety} until her lines are finished.

Act 4: After Daresso, do not enter Kaom's Dream until you have talked. After Kaom, stay out of The Belly of the Beast until you have talked. After Piety, do not enter @loc{The Harvest} until you have talked. Give Piety all the organs and speak to her before you kill @enemy{Malachai}.

Act 5: After Justicar Casticus, do not enter Oriath Square until you have talked. After Innocence, stay in @loc{The Chamber of Innocence} until you have talked to Sin. Do not enter the Torched Courts early. Once you hold the Sign of Purity, speak with Sin before you leave @loc{The Ossuary}.

Act 6: Do not use the Eye of Conquest on its door before you have talked to Tarkleigh. After you use it, talk to Tarkleigh again before the Karui Fortress. After Shavronne, talk to Sin before you leave. Once Nessa has spoken, keep out of @loc{The Western Forest} until you have talked. Talk to Weylam at @loc{The Brine King's Reef}.

Act 7: Talk to Helena before @loc{The Fellshrine Ruins}. After Maligaro, talk to Sin before you leave @loc{Maligaro's Sanctum}. After Greust, talk to Sin before you enter @loc{The Northern Forest}. After the fireflies, talk to Yeena before @loc{The Causeway}. After Arakaali, talk to Yeena before you leave @loc{The Temple of Decay}.

Act 8: Talk to Sin before and after you kill Doedre, and do not leave her area early. Deliver the Wings to Hargan and talk to Sin before you kill Yugul. After Tolman, talk to Clarissa before you leave @loc{The Quay}. Get both orbs and hear the two lines they open before you kill @enemy{Solaris} and @enemy{Lunaris}.

Act 9: Talk to Petarus and Vanja, then Sin, before @loc{The Foothills}. After Garukhan, talk to Sin first. Speak to neither Irasha nor Tasuni before then. Stay out of The Belly of the Beast until Sin has spoken in @loc{The Quarry}. After the Depraved Trinity, talk to Weylam before you leave for Act 10.

Act 10: After you free Bannon, return to town. Deliver the Staff to Bannon first, then talk to Lilly. Defeat @enemy{Kitava} and use the portal to Oriath Docks. The last needed line comes right after Kitava falls.
You can ignore league NPCs such as Einhar, Alva and the Expedition NPCs. The Kirac and Maven epilogue lines and many side quest lines do not count.

achievements.description: Create a Unique item using an Orb of Chance.
achievements.summary: Turn a Normal item into a Unique with an Orb of Chance.

guide.context: Most tries give a Magic or Rare item. A base with a low-tier Unique version works best.

steps.text: Pick a Normal item whose base has a Unique version of low tier.
Use an @item{Orb of Chance} on it.
If the item becomes Magic or Rare, use an @item{Orb of Scouring} on it and try again.

achievements.description: Create an item with six linked sockets using an Orb of Fusing.
achievements.summary: Give one item six linked sockets by using an Orb of Fusing.

guide.context: The item needs six sockets first. Expect to use over 1000 orbs, and quality on the item helps.

steps.text: Get an item that has six sockets. Raise its quality if you can.
Stock up on @item{Orb of Fusing}. Plan for around 1500.
Use the orbs on the item one after another until all six sockets are linked.

achievements.description: Have a Skill Gem reach level 20.
achievements.summary: Level one skill gem to level 20.

guide.context: A gem only earns experience while it sits in equipped gear.

steps.text: Socket a skill gem you use all the time into your equipped gear.
Keep playing until the gem reaches level 20. Hover over it to see its progress.

achievements.description: Have 15 combined Endurance, Frenzy, and Power Charges active simultaneously.
achievements.summary: Hold 15 Endurance, Frenzy and Power Charges combined, all active together.

guide.context: The 15 are combined, for example 5 of each type. You need at least one of each type.

steps.text: Raise the maximum of @mechanic{Endurance}, @mechanic{Frenzy} and @mechanic{Power} Charges with gear, gems, ascendancy points or passive points.
Gain all three types of charge, and keep them active until the total is 15.

achievements.description: Slay an enemy that is simultaneously Ignited, Shocked, and Frozen.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy that is Ignited, Shocked and Frozen at once.

steps.text: Run the @item{Hatred} and @item{Wrath} auras and use a weapon or skill that deals fire damage.
Hit one enemy until it is Ignited, Shocked and Frozen at once, then land the killing blow.

achievements.description: Equip a Rare or Unique item in every non-Flask slot.
achievements.summary: Fill every equipment slot except the Flask slots with Rare or Unique gear.

guide.context: A two-handed weapon does not cover both weapon slots.

steps.text: Collect a @item{Rare} (yellow) or @item{Unique} (orange) item for every non-Flask slot.
Equip them all together. No slot may be empty or hold a Normal or Magic item.

achievements.description: Shatter 5 monsters with a single action.
achievements.summary: Shatter 5 frozen monsters with one action.

steps.text: Gather a pack of at least 5 monsters. Freeze them with a cold skill such as @item{Freezing Pulse}, or with the @item{Hatred} aura.
Kill all five frozen monsters with a single action so they shatter.

achievements.description: Equip a Unique item.
achievements.summary: Equip a unique item.

steps.text: Equip any @item{Unique} item. They drop often during normal play.

achievements.description: Allocate a Keystone Passive Skill.
achievements.summary: Allocate one keystone on the passive skill tree.

steps.text: Open the passive skill tree and spend points on a path to a large round @mechanic{Keystone} node. Allocate it.

achievements.description: Fully clear an end-game Map area.
achievements.summary: Fully clear one end-game Map area.

guide.context: The /remaining chat command shows the monsters still alive in the area.

steps.text: Finish the quest @mechanic{A Call to Arms} to unlock the Atlas and the Map Device.
Put a @item{Map} in the Map Device, pick an area of that tier or lower, and click Activate.
Enter a portal and kill every monster in the area, including bosses.

achievements.description: Help all three Bandit Lords.
achievements.summary: Help each of the three Bandit Lords: Kraityn, Alira and Oak.

guide.context: Only one lord can be active at a time. The kill-all choice from Eramir cancels your help for a lord, and the vendor recipe in the steps changes the choice afterward.

steps.text: In Act 2, take @mechanic{Deal with the Bandits} from @npc{Eramir}.
Help one lord and kill the other two: @enemy{Kraityn} is at @loc{The Broken Bridge}, @enemy{Alira} at @loc{The Western Forest} and @enemy{Oak} at @loc{The Wetlands}.
To help another lord on the same character, sell 20 @item{Orb of Regret} and an amulet to a vendor: Jade for Kraityn, Lapis for Alira, Amber for Oak. Use the @item{Book of Reform} you get.
Repeat until you have helped Kraityn, Alira and Oak. Type /passives to see your current choice.

achievements.description: Open a Large Chest.
achievements.summary: Open a Large Chest.

guide.context: Only two maps have a counting chest. The chest in The Twilight Strand does not count.

steps.text: Get the unique map @loc{Vaults of Atziri} or @loc{Acton's Nightmare}, and open it in a Map Device.
Find the @item{Large Chest} in the map and open it.

achievements.description: Have 3 Totems alive at one time.
achievements.summary: Have 3 totems alive at the same time.

steps.text: Take the @mechanic{Ancestral Bond} keystone and equip the Searing Bond gem.
Place the totem 3 times so that all 3 stand together.

achievements.description: Reach level 8 in any Race Event.
achievements.summary: Get a character to level 8 while playing in a Race event.

guide.context: Seasonal races are no longer held. Races now run as events, which the game only sometimes opens as a challenge league winds down. Each one starts every character fresh with an empty stash.

steps.text: Join an event when one is running and start a fresh character in it.
Reach level 8 before the event ends.

achievements.description: Capture a Flag in PvP.
achievements.summary: Capture a flag in a Capture the Flag PvP match.

guide.context: Each side plays as a team of 3. Every player must play their own match to earn the achievement.

steps.text: Form a party of 3 and find a second team of 3.
Open the Events and PvP tab (hotkey B), choose Capture the Flag and queue.
Take the flag from the enemy war camp and return it.

achievements.description: Have 9 Raised Zombies at the same time.
achievements.summary: Have 9 raised zombies alive at the same time.

steps.text: Equip gear and passives that add to your zombie limit.
Cast Raise Zombie until 9 zombies stand together.

achievements.description: Have at least 75% resistance to Fire, Cold, and Lightning.
achievements.summary: Hold 75% or more Fire, Cold, and Lightning resistance at once.

steps.text: Add resistance from gear and passives until Fire, Cold, and Lightning each show at least 75%.
Resistance flasks add to the total. Check your values in a safe zone such as your hideout.

achievements.description: Have a Unique Map drop within a Unique Map.
achievements.summary: While inside a unique map, receive a unique map as a drop.

steps.text: Run a unique map with a strong drop, such as @loc{Caer Blaidd, Wolfpack's Den}. Its boss drops 4 additional maps.
Kill the boss and check the drops for a unique map.
Run the map again until a unique map drops.

achievements.description: Have a Unique Item drop in the Twilight Strand in Act 1.
achievements.summary: Get a unique item to drop in Act 1's Twilight Strand.

steps.text: Start a new character and go straight to @enemy{Hillock} in @loc{The Twilight Strand}.
Kill him and the monsters on the way and look for a unique item.
If nothing unique drops, start the character again. Gear with item rarity raises the chance.

achievements.description: Fully clear the Dread Thicket.
achievements.summary: Fully clear the Dread Thicket.

steps.text: Enter @loc{The Dread Thicket} in Act 2 from @loc{The Northern Forest} and kill every monster.
If the achievement has not unlocked, also clear the Act 7 @loc{The Dread Thicket}.
The /remaining command shows how many monsters are still alive.

achievements.description: Allocate a character's fourth Keystone Passive.
achievements.summary: Allocate four keystone passive skills on one character.

steps.text: Open the passive tree and spend points on the large round keystones until you have taken 4.

achievements.description: Fully clear the Catacombs.
achievements.summary: Fully clear the Catacombs.

steps.text: In Act 3, enter @loc{The Catacombs} from @loc{The Marketplace} and kill every monster, including the bosses.
The monsters deal mostly cold damage, so bring cold resistance. The /remaining command shows how many are still alive.

achievements.description: Have 90% resistance to any Element.
achievements.summary: Have 90% resistance to any one element.

steps.text: Pick one element and stack its resistance on gear and passives.
Add a matching resistance flask, then check the value in your hideout until it shows 90%.

achievements.description: Fully clear the Archives.
achievements.summary: Fully clear the Archives.

steps.text: In Act 3, enter @loc{The Archives} from @loc{The Library}.
Kill every monster in the rooms, including @enemy{Trinian, Intellectus Prime}.
The /remaining command shows how many monsters are still alive.

achievements.description: Join a public party.
achievements.summary: Join a public party.

steps.text: Open the social panel and go to Public Parties.
Pick a party and press Join.

achievements.description: Fully clear the Ship Graveyard Cave.
achievements.summary: Fully clear the Ship Graveyard Cave.

steps.text: In Act 1, enter @loc{The Ship Graveyard Cave} from @loc{The Ship Graveyard}.
Kill every monster, including @enemy{Stranglecharm}.
The exit near the end is one way. Finish the clear before you use it.

achievements.description: Have a Vaal Skill Gem reach level 20.
achievements.summary: Raise a Vaal skill gem to level 20.

guide.context: A gem gains experience only while it is socketed in worn gear.

steps.text: Socket a Vaal skill gem in gear you wear and keep it there while you level.
Level the gem until it reaches 20.
You can buy a level 19 gem and level it once. A bought level 20 gem does not count.

achievements.description: Corrupt an item to have a white socket.
achievements.summary: Corrupt an item so that it gains a white socket.

guide.context: A corrupted item cannot be changed again, so every try needs a new item.

steps.text: Use a @item{Vaal Orb} on an item you do not need.
Repeat on new items until a corruption adds a white socket.

achievements.description: Have 60 Minions at the same time.
achievements.summary: Have 60 minions alive at the same time.

steps.text: Pick one item with four linked sockets. Linked sockets are joined by a line.
Put these gems in those sockets: @item{Dominating Blow}, @item{Melee Splash}, @item{Multistrike} and @item{Increased Duration}.
Go to a low-level area, where monsters are much weaker than you.
Attack enemies with Dominating Blow to raise zombies until 38 or more are alive.
Use the @item{Vaal Summon Skeletons} gem to add skeletons until 60 minions are alive.

achievements.description: Corrupt a map to have eight mods.
achievements.summary: Corrupt a map so that it ends up with eight modifiers.

guide.context: A corrupted map cannot be changed again, so every try needs a new map.

steps.text: Get a non-unique map.
Apply a @item{Vaal Orb} to it. The outcome that adds 2 modifiers can bring it toward 8 modifiers, up to a maximum of 9.
If the map does not end up with 8 modifiers, repeat with a new map.

achievements.description: Kill another player in any mode or league.
achievements.summary: Win a kill against another player in any league or game mode.

steps.text: Right-click another player and choose Challenge to Duel. A duel is best of 7 with a 90 second limit.
Or enter the free-for-all @loc{Sarn Arena} next to @loc{The Sarn Encampment} and kill a player there.

achievements.description: Corrupt a map into a Vaal Temple map.
achievements.summary: Corrupt a map so that it turns into a Vaal Temple map.

steps.text: Use a @item{Vaal Orb} on a Tier 16 map.
Repeat on new Tier 16 maps until one becomes a Vaal Temple Map.

achievements.description: Corrupt a skill gem into a Vaal skill gem.
achievements.summary: Corrupt a skill gem so that it turns into a Vaal skill gem.

steps.text: Apply a @item{Vaal Orb} to a spare skill gem.
Repeat on new gems until one becomes a Vaal skill gem.

achievements.description: Enhance a map with a Vaal fragment.
achievements.summary: Enchant a non-unique Tier 16 map with a Royal Visage.

steps.text: Get a @item{Royal Visage}. @enemy{Atziri} can drop one in a Temple of Atzoatl of level 81 or higher.
Right-click the Royal Visage, then left-click a non-unique Tier 16 map.

achievements.description: Corrupt an item to have a new implicit mod.
achievements.summary: Corrupt an item so that it gains a new implicit modifier.

guide.context: A corrupted item cannot be changed again, so every try needs a new item.

steps.text: Use a @item{Vaal Orb} on an item you do not need.
Repeat on new items until a corruption adds a new implicit modifier.

achievements.description: Kill Atziri in the Apex of Sacrifice.
achievements.summary: Defeat Atziri, Queen of the Vaal, inside the Temple of Atzoatl.

guide.context: The achievement now asks for her death in the temple, not in the old Apex of Sacrifice.

steps.text: Complete 12 temporal incursions with @npc{Alva Valai} to unlock the temple.
Use the Map Device to open portals into the @loc{Temple of Atzoatl}.
Reach the @loc{Apex of Atzoatl}, the top room. It must connect to a room below it, or break a wall with a @item{Flashpowder Keg} from an Explosives Room.
Kill @enemy{Atziri, Queen of the Vaal}. At 75%, 50% and 25% life she splits into four copies. Kill one copy to damage her again.
She reflects curses, so do not curse her.

achievements.description: Fully clear the Colosseum or Pit end-game Map.
achievements.summary: Fully clear the Colosseum or Pit end-game map.

steps.text: Get a Colosseum Map or a Pit Map and open it in a Map Device.
Kill every monster, including @enemy{Ambrius, Legion Slayer}.

achievements.description: Fully clear The Harvest.
achievements.summary: Fully clear The Harvest in Act 4.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Doedre Darktongue}, @enemy{Maligaro, The Inquisitor} and @enemy{Shavronne of Umbra} in @loc{The Harvest}.
Enter @loc{The Black Core} and kill @enemy{Malachai, The Nightmare}.
Kill every other monster left in the area.
The /remaining command shows how many monsters are still alive.

achievements.description: Kill Voll, Emperor of Purity.
achievements.summary: Kill Voll, Emperor of Purity.

steps.text: In Act 4, go to @loc{The Dried Lake} and kill @enemy{Voll, Emperor of Purity}.

achievements.description: Kill Shavronne of Umbra.
achievements.summary: Kill Shavronne of Umbra.

guide.context: This fight is part of the quest Corpus Malachus. The three bosses open @loc{The Black Core}.

steps.text: In Act 4, go to @loc{The Harvest} and kill @enemy{Shavronne of Umbra}.

achievements.description: Kill Doedre Darktongue.
achievements.summary: Kill Doedre Darktongue.

guide.context: This fight is part of the quest Corpus Malachus. The three bosses open @loc{The Black Core}.

steps.text: In Act 4, go to @loc{The Harvest} and kill @enemy{Doedre Darktongue}.

achievements.description: Kill Maligaro, The Inquisitor.
achievements.summary: Kill Maligaro, The Inquisitor.

guide.context: This fight is part of the quest Corpus Malachus. The three bosses open @loc{The Black Core}.

steps.text: In Act 4, go to @loc{The Harvest} and kill @enemy{Maligaro, The Inquisitor}.

achievements.description: Kill the Eater of Souls in the Core end-game Map.
achievements.summary: Kill Eater of Souls, the boss of the Core end-game map.

guide.context: Eater of Souls fights like Malachai, The Nightmare.

steps.text: Find @loc{Core} in the northeast part of the Atlas and get a @item{Core Map} for it.
Use the Core Map in a personal Map Device or the Templar Laboratory.
Kill @enemy{Eater of Souls} at the end of the map.

achievements.description: Hand in a full set of Divination Cards.
achievements.summary: Hand in a full set of one divination card type to a trader.

guide.context: Cards drop in particular areas, so choose one you can farm.

steps.text: Collect divination cards until you hold a full stack of one type.
Give the stack to @npc{Tasuni} in @loc{Highgate} or to @npc{Lilly Roth} in your hideout.
Ctrl and left click puts a stack into the trade window.

achievements.description: Kill Malachai, The Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Kill Malachai, The Nightmare.

guide.context: One kill is enough. You do not need a kill with every class.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Doedre Darktongue}, @enemy{Maligaro, The Inquisitor} and @enemy{Shavronne of Umbra} in @loc{The Harvest}.
Enter @loc{The Black Core} and kill @enemy{Malachai, The Nightmare}.

achievements.description: Reserve 95% or more of your Life.
achievements.summary: Have 95% or more of your maximum life reserved.

steps.text: Link Blood Magic with auras such as Anger so they reserve life instead of mana.
Add auras until at least 95% of your life is reserved.

achievements.description: Land the killing blow on the Vaal Oversoul while you have the Fortify Buff active.
achievements.summary: Deliver the final hit to the Vaal Oversoul with Fortify running.

guide.context: If the kill happens without Fortify, a new character may be needed.

steps.text: Get a Fortify source, such as the @item{Vigilant Strike} skill. Its melee hits give Fortify for 8 seconds.
In Act 2, climb to the top of the @loc{Ancient Pyramid} and fight @enemy{Vaal Oversoul}.
Keep Fortify active and land the last hit while it is up.
Do not kill the Oversoul without Fortify on this character.

achievements.description: Kill a Rogue Exile in Kaom's Stronghold.
achievements.summary: Defeat a rogue exile inside Kaom's Stronghold.

steps.text: In Act 4, enter @loc{Kaom's Stronghold} and look for a rogue exile, a unique monster that looks like another player.
Kill it. If none appears, make a new instance of the area and look again.

achievements.description: Land the killing blow on the Burning Man while you are burning.
achievements.summary: Deliver the final blow to the Burning Man while you are on fire.

steps.text: In Act 4, find @enemy{The Burning Man} in @loc{The Crystal Veins}.
Stand in his fire until you are burning, then land the killing blow.

achievements.description: Open a Vaal Vessel in a corrupted zone.
achievements.summary: Open a Vaal Vessel found in a corrupted area.

steps.text: Enter a corrupted Vaal side area, or a Vaal Temple Map with 10 guarded Vaal Vessels.
Kill the boss that guards the @item{Vaal Vessel}.
Open the Vaal Vessel.

achievements.description: Equip each Maraketh Weapon type.
achievements.summary: Equip every Maraketh weapon type.

guide.context: Maraketh weapons drop from Act 4 onward. The top tier of each class needs about character level 70.

achievements.description: Craft a Jewel with four mods using an Orb of Alchemy.
achievements.summary: Craft a jewel with four modifiers using an Orb of Alchemy.

steps.text: Use an @item{Orb of Alchemy} on a normal jewel.
If it has fewer than four modifiers, strip it with an @item{Orb of Scouring} and use another Orb of Alchemy.

achievements.description: Corrupt a Unique Jewel into a different Unique Jewel.
achievements.summary: Corrupt a unique jewel so that it turns into a different unique jewel.

guide.context: A corrupted jewel cannot be changed again, so every try needs a new jewel.

steps.text: Apply a @item{Vaal Orb} to a spare unique jewel.
Repeat on new unique jewels until one turns into a different unique jewel.

achievements.description: Equip a Unique Jewel with a radius.
achievements.summary: Equip a unique jewel that has a radius.

steps.text: Get a unique jewel whose text shows a radius, such as Brute Force Solution.
Place it in a jewel socket you have already allocated on the tree.

achievements.description: Defeat The Elder.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Elder.

guide.context: Only the single @enemy{The Elder} fight counts. The two-boss @enemy{Uber Elder} fight is not needed.

steps.text: Collect the four @item{Key to Decay} fragments: Purification, Constriction, Enslavement and Eradication. They drop from the @enemy{Elder Guardians}. You can also trade for them.
Put all four in the @mechanic{Map Device} and enter @loc{Absence of Value and Meaning}.
Kill @enemy{The Elder}.

achievements.description: Complete Part 1.
achievements.summary: Complete Part 1 of the campaign, which is Acts 1 to 5.

steps.text: Finish the main quest of every act from @loc{Act 1} to @loc{Act 5}, in order.

achievements.description: Kill Tsoagoth, the Brine King.
achievements.summary: Kill Tsoagoth, the Brine King.

steps.text: In @loc{Act 6}, go through @loc{The Beacon} to @loc{The Brine King's Reef}.
Kill @enemy{Tsoagoth, the Brine King}.

achievements.description: Kill Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows.
achievements.summary: Kill Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows.

steps.text: In @loc{Act 7}, reach @loc{The Vaal City} and enter @loc{The Temple of Decay}.
Kill @enemy{Arakaali, Spinner of Shadows} inside the temple.

achievements.description: Kill both Lunaris and Solaris in the same encounter.
achievements.summary: Defeat the gods Lunaris and Solaris together during a single boss fight.

steps.text: In @loc{Act 8}, finish @loc{The Solaris Temple} and @loc{The Lunaris Temple}.
Go to @loc{The Harbour Bridge} and enter the @loc{Sky Shrine}, where @enemy{Solaris} and @enemy{Lunaris} fight together.
Kill both gods in that one fight.

achievements.description: Kill the Depraved Trinity.
achievements.summary: Kill the Depraved Trinity.

steps.text: In @loc{Act 9}, reach @loc{The Rotting Core} during the quest Recurring Nightmare.
Kill @enemy{The Depraved Trinity}.
At 75%, 50% and 25% health it leaves and summons six @enemy{Unholy Aberrations}. Kill them and wait for it to return.

achievements.description: Complete Part 2.
achievements.summary: Complete Part 2 of the campaign, which is Acts 6 to 10.

steps.text: Finish the main quest of every act from @loc{Act 6} to @loc{Act 10}.
Kill @enemy{Kitava, the Insatiable} at the end of @loc{Act 10}. Part 2 ends when the Epilogue starts.

achievements.description: Have a Voidstone socketed in your Atlas.
achievements.summary: Put one Voidstone into a slot of your Atlas.

guide.context: A Voidstone drops the first time you beat a set of pinnacle bosses. Each set gives a different Voidstone: @enemy{The Maven}; @enemy{The Shaper} plus @enemy{The Elder}; @enemy{The Searing Exarch} plus @enemy{The Eater of Worlds}; or the @enemy{Incarnation of Dread}.

steps.text: Beat one set of pinnacle bosses that drops a @item{Voidstone}.
Open the @mechanic{Atlas} and socket the Voidstone into one of the four corner slots.

achievements.description: Have two Voidstones socketed in your Atlas.
achievements.summary: Put two Voidstones into slots of your Atlas.

guide.context: Each boss set gives its own Voidstone, so the second one must come from a different set than the first.

steps.text: Beat a second set of pinnacle bosses that drops a @item{Voidstone}.
Socket it into a second corner slot of the @mechanic{Atlas}.

achievements.description: Have three Voidstones socketed in your Atlas.
achievements.summary: Put three Voidstones into slots of your Atlas.

guide.context: Each boss set gives its own Voidstone, so you need three different sets.

steps.text: Beat a third set of pinnacle bosses that drops a @item{Voidstone}.
Socket it into a third corner slot of the @mechanic{Atlas}.

achievements.description: Complete every map on the Atlas.
achievements.summary: Complete every map on the Atlas.

guide.context: The Atlas has about 100 regular maps in four quadrants, plus unique maps. Finishing a map reveals the maps next to it.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{Atlas}, pick a map and kill its boss to complete it. Work outward from the centre of each quadrant.
Repeat until every map is complete, including the unique maps on the Atlas.
If you already own any @item{Voidstone}, finishing one map completes every map of the same tier or lower.

achievements.description: Complete the Hall of Grandmasters.
achievements.summary: Complete the Hall of Grandmasters.

guide.context: The Grandmasters are other players' characters. PvP damage scaling applies here. Minions die very fast, so do not rely on them.

steps.text: Get a @item{Hall of Grandmasters} map. It can drop in any area.
Open it from the @mechanic{Atlas} in the southeast quadrant.
Beat the Grandmasters in all four halls. Each hall sends 50 of them in waves of 5.
Open the @item{Grandmaster's Cache} at the end of each hall.

achievements.description: Kill Atziri in the Alluring Abyss.
achievements.summary: Slay Atziri inside a Temple of Atzoatl that includes the Cradle of Creation room.

guide.context: Pausing is turned off in this fight.

steps.text: Kill @enemy{Atziri} once in a @loc{Temple of Atzoatl} at area level 81 or higher. She drops a @item{Royal Visage}.
Use the Royal Visage on a Tier 16 map that is not unique. That map now has Alluring Temporal Incursions.
Enter the Alluring incursion so that @npc{Xipocado, Architect to the Queen} joins the temple and the @mechanic{Cradle of Creation} room is added.
Open the temple with @npc{Alva}'s portal or a @item{Chronicle of Atzoatl}, go to the top room and kill @enemy{Atziri}. The temple that has the @mechanic{Cradle of Creation} room is area level 84.

achievements.description: Complete a Tier 11 or higher Map with a Horned Scarab applied.
achievements.summary: Finish a map of at least Tier 14 after spending eight Threads on it.

steps.text: Get eight @item{Threads}. Maps in a Shaped Region of your @mechanic{Atlas} come with free Threads of that region's type; collect more for the rest. Any Thread type counts toward the total.
Put a Tier 14 or higher map and all eight Threads into the @mechanic{Map Device}, then open the portal.
Complete that map by killing its boss.

achievements.description: Kill It That Was Esh and It That Was Tul.
achievements.summary: Kill the paired Breach bosses Tul and Esh in the Hive Colony.

guide.context: They are one fight in the @loc{Hive Colony}.

steps.text: Get a @item{Hivebrain Gland} by killing @enemy{Vruun, Marshal of Xesht} or by finishing an encounter in a @loc{Hive Fortress}.
Use the gland in your @mechanic{Map Device}. Its portal leads to the @loc{Hive Colony}, a Tier 15 area on your @mechanic{Atlas}.
Kill @enemy{It That Was Tul}, plus its partner @enemy{It That Was Esh}. They take turns until about 40% health, then share one health bar.

achievements.description: Choose an Ascendancy class.
achievements.summary: Choose an Ascendancy class.

steps.text: Finish six @mechanic{Trials of Ascendancy} spread over @loc{Act 1}, @loc{Act 2} and @loc{Act 3}: one, two and three trials.
Use the statue in the @loc{Sarn Encampment} to reach the @loc{Aspirants' Plaza}, enter the @loc{Labyrinth} and beat @enemy{Izaro} in all three Aspirant's Trials without dying.
Click the @mechanic{Altar of Ascendancy} in the Ascendancy Chamber and pick your class.

achievements.description: Complete the Vinktar Square.
achievements.summary: Complete the Vinktar Square.

steps.text: Find @loc{The Vinktar Square} on the @mechanic{Atlas} in the southwest quadrant, next to @loc{Courthouse}, and open it.
Kill the four guardians in the corners: north, east, south and west.
Go through the gate that opens in the centre and kill the @enemy{Avatar of Thunder}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Shaper.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Shaper.

steps.text: Beat the bosses of the four Guardian maps: @loc{Lair of the Hydra}, @loc{Pit of the Chimera}, @loc{Forge of the Phoenix} and @loc{Maze of the Minotaur}. Each drops one fragment. You can also trade for them.
Put all four fragments in the @mechanic{Map Device} and enter @loc{The Shaper's Realm}.
Kill @enemy{The Shaper}.

achievements.description: Complete the Eternal Labyrinth in a non-Hardcore league.
achievements.summary: Finish the Eternal Labyrinth on a character in a league that is not Hardcore.

guide.context: Leaving the Labyrinth for any reason ends the run.

steps.text: Finish the Merciless Labyrinth once and reach level 68.
Get an @item{Offering to the Goddess} from a Labyrinth trial in a Tier 6 or higher map, from another league mechanic, or by trade.
Spend the offering at the @loc{Aspirants' Plaza}, then beat @enemy{Izaro} in all three trials of the @loc{Eternal Labyrinth}.

achievements.description: Complete the Eternal Labyrinth in a Hardcore League.
achievements.summary: Finish the Eternal Labyrinth on a character in a Hardcore league.

steps.text: On a Hardcore character, finish the Merciless Labyrinth once and reach level 68.
Get an @item{Offering to the Goddess} from a Labyrinth trial in a Tier 6 or higher map, from another league mechanic, or by trade. Spend it at the @loc{Aspirants' Plaza}.
Beat @enemy{Izaro} in all three trials of the @loc{Eternal Labyrinth} without dying.

achievements.description: Kill High Templar Dominus.
achievements.summary: Kill High Templar Dominus.

guide.context: Any class works. One kill is enough.

steps.text: In @loc{Act 3}, reach @loc{The Upper Sceptre of God}.
Kill @enemy{High Templar Dominus}.

achievements.description: Kill Argus.
achievements.summary: Kill Argus.

guide.context: Argus appears only in the Merciless and Eternal Labyrinths. The Labyrinth layout changes every day at midnight UTC, and his room stays the same all day.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Merciless Labyrinth} or the @loc{Eternal Labyrinth}. The Merciless one needs the Cruel Labyrinth done, level 50 and three Act 8 to 10 trials.
Find @enemy{Argus} in this day's layout and kill him.

achievements.description: Kill Izaro and have him drop 3 treasure keys.
achievements.summary: Defeat Izaro so that he drops three Treasure Keys.

guide.context: The Cruel Labyrinth has more Izaro mechanics and the Merciless Labyrinth has all of them, so Merciless gives the most extra keys.

steps.text: In the first two Aspirant's Trials, do not turn off Izaro's extra mechanics. Leave @mechanic{Conduits}, @mechanic{Gargoyles}, @mechanic{Lieutenants}, @mechanic{Portals} and @mechanic{Fonts} alone.
Do not use @mechanic{Charge Disruptors}. Let all three @mechanic{Idols} activate once. Let the @mechanic{Essences} bond with Izaro or stay alive.
Kill @enemy{Izaro} in the final trial with every mechanic still in place. He drops one extra @item{Treasure Key} for each mechanic left, so keep as many as you can.
The extra mechanics make Izaro stronger. Cap your resistances first.

achievements.description: Kill a god and obtain their power.
achievements.summary: Kill a god and obtain their Pantheon power.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Act 6} and kill a god boss, such as @enemy{Tsoagoth, the Brine King}.
Press Y to open the @mechanic{Pantheon} screen and check that the new power is listed.

achievements.description: Equip two unique items with the same name.
achievements.summary: Equip two unique items that have the same name.

steps.text: Pick a unique item that fits in two slots, such as a ring or a one-handed weapon. Cheap ones are enough.
Get two copies and equip both.

achievements.description: Complete a map area that is affected by 10 or more modifiers.
achievements.summary: Finish a map whose area has ten or more modifiers on it.

steps.text: Before you open the map, check its area modifier list. Modifiers from outside the map item also count toward the total. Only go in once the list shows 10 or more.
Open that map and complete it by killing its boss.

achievements.description: Open a map in the map device and step through its portal.
achievements.summary: Use the Map Device to open a map, then walk through the portal that opens.

steps.text: Take the Tier 1 map from @npc{Commander Kirac} for the quest @mechanic{A Call to Arms}.
Put it in the @mechanic{Map Device}, choose an area, press Activate and step through a portal.

achievements.description: Kill Beidat, Archangel of Death.
achievements.summary: Kill Beidat, Archangel of Death.

guide.context: Only one Beyond faction spawns per area. @enemy{Beidat} leads the Pale Scourge. The boss spawn is random, so you may need several maps.

steps.text: Run a map that has a Beyond encounter. Click the @mechanic{Demonic Evocator} near the entrance.
Kill monsters. When red orbs merge, kill the Beyond demons that appear. Each pack makes a boss more likely.
If the boss is not @enemy{Beidat}, finish the map and try another one. Kill @enemy{Beidat, Archangel of Death}.

achievements.description: Complete a Master's Atlas Mission.
achievements.summary: Complete a Master's Atlas Mission.

guide.context: Masters no longer hand out missions on the Atlas screen. They now appear inside maps.

steps.text: Apply a @item{Thread} to a map so a Master can appear: Bestiary for @npc{Einhar}, Incursion for @npc{Alva} or Betrayal for @npc{Jun}.
In the map, finish the Master's encounter. If the achievement does not unlock, repeat with another Master.

achievements.description: Defeat each Master's most dangerous foe.
achievements.summary: Defeat each Master's most dangerous foe.

guide.context: This achievement cannot be unlocked now. Alva's foe, the Vaal Omnitect, was removed from the Temple of Atzoatl in patch 3.30.0, and the achievement needs all five foes.

collectibles.name: Alva: The Vaal Omnitect
collectibles.method: The Omnitect was removed from the Temple in patch 3.30.0, so this foe cannot be killed now.

achievements.description: Corrupt an Essence monster with a Vaal Orb.
achievements.summary: Use a Vaal Orb on an Essence monster to corrupt its Essences.

steps.text: Find an @mechanic{Essence Monolith}, which is a crystal with a trapped monster. They appear in acts and maps.
Use a @item{Vaal Orb} on the monolith before you click it to release the monster.
Click the monolith three times to free the monster.

achievements.description: Kill a monster that is under the influence of five Essence mods.
achievements.summary: Kill a monster that has five Essence modifiers.

guide.context: Few monsters get five Essences by chance.

steps.text: Take the Atlas passives that add Essences to imprisoned monsters, such as @mechanic{Crystal Lattice}.
Run maps with @mechanic{Essence Monolith}s. Use a @item{Vaal Orb} on a monolith to try to add an Essence type.
Free a monster that has five Essences and kill it.

achievements.description: Use an orb to change the mods of a Strongbox.
achievements.summary: Use a currency orb to change the modifiers of a strongbox.

steps.text: Find a @mechanic{Strongbox} in an act or map, but do not open it yet.
Use an orb on it, such as an @item{Orb of Transmutation}. Then open the box.

achievements.description: Have four Voidstones socketed in your Atlas.
achievements.summary: Put four Voidstones into slots of your Atlas.

guide.context: You need all four boss groups, in any order. The last group is the @enemy{Incarnation of Dread}. The other three are @enemy{The Maven}, @enemy{The Shaper} with @enemy{The Elder}, and @enemy{The Searing Exarch} with @enemy{The Eater of Worlds}.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{The Maven}, @enemy{The Shaper} plus @enemy{The Elder}, and @enemy{The Searing Exarch} plus @enemy{The Eater of Worlds}, in any order.

For the @enemy{Incarnation of Dread}, finish the quest @loc{Threads of the Originator}. Later runs open the @loc{Moment of Reverence} with an @item{Echo of Reverence} or four @item{Reverent Fragments} in your @mechanic{Map Device}.
Kill the Incarnation of Dread. Each first defeat drops a @item{Voidstone}.
Socket all four Voidstones into the corner slots of the @mechanic{Atlas}.

achievements.description: Defeat Sirus, Awakener of Worlds.
achievements.summary: Defeat Sirus, Awakener of Worlds.

steps.text: Defeat the four conquerors @enemy{Al-Hezmin}, @enemy{Baran}, @enemy{Drox} and @enemy{Veritania}, and collect their map fragments.
Clear the map beside the @loc{Eye of the Storm} node on the @mechanic{Atlas} so that node opens.
Load the @item{Crest of the Elderslayers} pieces into the @mechanic{Map Device} and enter the @loc{Eye of the Storm}.
Kill @enemy{Sirus, Awakener of Worlds}.

achievements.description: Accept The Maven's Invitation and defeat The Maven.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Maven after you accept a Maven's Invitation.

steps.text: Progress the @npc{Maven}'s questline to unlock the @mechanic{Maven's Beacon}.
Use the Beacon on the @mechanic{Map Device}. Kill map bosses while she witnesses to earn @item{Maven's Invitation}s. Complete them to collect @item{Crescent Splinters}.
Combine enough splinters into @item{The Maven's Writ}. Use it in the Map Device to enter @loc{Absence of Mercy and Empathy}.
Kill @enemy{The Maven}.

achievements.description: Defeat The Black Star.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Black Star.

guide.context: You must beat this boss before you can fight @enemy{The Searing Exarch}.

steps.text: Follow the quest steps of @mechanic{The Searing Exarch} until you get a @item{Polaric Invitation}.
Use it in the @mechanic{Map Device} to enter @loc{Polaric Void}.
Kill @enemy{The Black Star}.
The arena has a fire half and a cold half. Standing in one stacks a debuff, and the stacks drop fast in the other half.
